_comment: Provenance ledger for the /frill pipeline. Maps a Frill idea idx to what the pipeline decided and produced, so re-runs never reprocess the same idea and every deliverable is traceable back to customer demand. Committed to git; contains no customer PII and no private-idea content. Decisions: routed-feature | routed-story | bug | rejected | deferred. Optional 'shipped' block records release/release_date/helpin_task/commit once the work ships. Optional 'announced' block records announcement_idx/date/status once it reaches the Frill changelog. Optional 'frill_status' block records a board status change once the PO approves it. Together these close the loop: customer asked -> we built -> we told them -> the board says so.

idea_10wp3prg.name: Workspace Deletion Permission for Admins
idea_10wp3prg.note: Per-admin canDeleteWorkspace permission, default off, super-admin-managed, mirroring hasBillingAccess. Research found a latent bug in the workspace policy that must be fixed in the same change.

idea_g6n0n08e.name: Make links in the copy clickable directly from the text editor so they open in a new tab.
idea_g6n0n08e.note: Requested by Camilo, 1 vote. Shipped in the shared CstSocialEditor via EditorLinkAffordance.vue, so it applies anywhere that editor is used, not only the composer. Announced in the 3.5.43 changelog under Other Improvements and Fixes.
